description: Internal configuration doorbell: re-reads the authoritative sentinel entry and swaps the live settings.

request_schema.description: The `configuration::on-updated` event, delivered as output to `<worker>::on-config-change`. Advisory only: handlers read `id` and re-fetch the authoritative value, so a direct call can never inject config.
request_schema.title: OnConfigChangeEvent

response_schema.description: Ack returned by the internal `<worker>::on-config-change` handler.
response_schema.title: OnConfigChangeResponse
